groups.name: AesCcmEncryptionBenchmarks
groups.description: AES-CCM encrypt and decrypt of fixed 1 KB / 1 MB / 10 MB random buffers (size encoded in the method name); decrypt cases reuse ciphertext from setup.

groups.name: AesGcmEncryptionBenchmarks
groups.description: AES-GCM encrypt and decrypt of fixed 1 KB / 1 MB / 10 MB random buffers (size encoded in the method name); decrypt cases reuse ciphertext from setup.

groups.name: AesGcmRsaEncryptionBenchmarks
groups.description: Hybrid AES-GCM + RSA envelope encrypt/decrypt of fixed 1 KB / 1 MB / 10 MB random buffers: RSA wraps a per-message AES key while AES-GCM encrypts the bulk payload.

groups.name: AesSivEncryptionBenchmarks
groups.description: AES-SIV (nonce-misuse-resistant) encrypt and decrypt of fixed 1 KB / 1 MB / 10 MB random buffers; decrypt cases reuse ciphertext from setup.

groups.name: AlgorithmComparisonBenchmarks
groups.description: Encrypts and decrypts the same random buffer with every supported AEAD cipher to compare throughput at each payload size. Decrypt cases reuse a ciphertext produced once in setup.

measurements.slaStandard: Single-pass AEAD with hardware acceleration (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305) should sustain >= 300 MB/s for bulk (>= 64 KB) payloads; 1 KB payloads are overhead-bound and not graded on throughput.
AES-CCM is two-pass (CBC-MAC then CTR) with no single-pass AEAD hardware path, so it runs well below AES-GCM; >= 50 MB/s is the acceptable floor when CCM interop is required.
AES-SIV is nonce-misuse-resistant (S2V + CTR, two passes) and inherently slower; >= 35 MB/s is acceptable when nonce-reuse safety is the priority.

name: encryption
title: Encryption
description: Symmetric authenticated-encryption throughput for Lyo.Encryption: AES-GCM/CCM/SIV and ChaCha20-Poly1305/XChaCha20-Poly1305, encrypt and decrypt. Each run encrypts/decrypts a buffer of cryptographically random bytes of the given DataSize (1 KB to 100 MB) using a fixed local key store, so timings reflect raw per-byte cipher throughput.
